Statement II: Rheumatoid arthritis is a condition where body does not attack self cells. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

statements.label: I
statements.text: Autoimmune disorder is a condition where body defense mechanism recognizes its own cells as foreign bodies.

statements.label: II
statements.text: Rheumatoid arthritis is a condition where body does not attack self cells.

options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options_en.4: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
